market_name: Will Ukraine agree to give up the rest of Donbas before 2027?

predictions.asset: Poland equity (geopolitical risk proxy for Russia-Ukraine de-escalation)

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the probability move coincides with concrete diplomatic headlines (ceasefire talks, Witkoff/Putin/Zelensky statements) versus thin-liquidity noise on Polymarket.
time_plan.1h: Compare EPOL/zloty premarket or intraday reaction to European equity futures and gas; confirm correlated risk-on across the region.
time_plan.2h: Reassess if the prob move holds or fades; look for official Ukrainian/Russian denials that would reverse the thesis.
time_plan.6h: Evaluate whether mainstream wire services corroborate any deal; a confirmed public report means the information is no longer a leak and move may be priced.
time_plan.12h: Mark-to-market EPOL vs entry, note whether move exceeded the 700bps tradable threshold and whether diplomatic narrative sustained.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability that Ukraine cedes Donbas under a diplomatic deal signals real progress toward a Russia-Ukraine settlement. Poland is the most liquid frontline-adjacent equity market; de-escalation compresses the regional war-risk premium, lowers reconstruction/refugee overhangs, and tends to lift Polish equities and the zloty. EPOL is a cleaner, liquid proxy than single names.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: ProShares Ultra Bloomberg Natural Gas (proxy for gas complex)

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify the Polymarket move is backed by genuine ceasefire/diplomatic signals rather than low-liquidity repricing.
time_plan.1h: Look at European TTF futures directly if accessible; US gas proxy may diverge due to weather/storage drivers unrelated to the war.
time_plan.2h: Check whether energy desks attribute any gas move to Ukraine headlines versus domestic supply/demand factors.
time_plan.6h: Reassess proxy validity; if US gas is dominated by weather, down-weight or drop this leg.
time_plan.12h: Mark-to-market and record that European gas, not US gas, is the true exposure; note mapping weakness in postmortem.

predictions.reasoning: Progress toward a Ukraine-Russia settlement would ease the war-risk premium embedded in European energy, with potential for eventual Russian pipeline flows to normalize. European TTF gas is the cleanest beneficiary, but it is hard to trade directly; US-listed gas proxies are weakly correlated to European gas, so this mapping is deliberately low-confidence. Direction is down on de-escalation, magnitude uncertain and proxy is noisy.

evidence_used: Market question ties a specific, verifiable diplomatic event (Ukraine ceding de facto control of named Donbas cities) to a Russia-Ukraine peace agreement
Historical pattern: Russia-Ukraine de-escalation news lifts regional (Polish) equities and the zloty and compresses European energy risk premia
Polymarket probability as a noisy early sensor of settlement odds
uncertainty_notes: A probability spike may reflect thin liquidity or a single rumor, not real diplomatic progress
If a deal is already widely reported, the move is public and largely priced into assets
US-listed gas ETFs are weak proxies for European TTF gas, the true war-risk-premium instrument
A ceded-Donbas deal could be read as Russian strength/escalation elsewhere, muddying risk-on interpretation

llm_justification.summary: The market prices the odds of a diplomatic deal where Ukraine cedes de facto control of remaining Donbas cities to Russia. A sharp rise in this probability signals genuine settlement progress, which historically compresses regional war-risk premia: Polish equities (EPOL) and the zloty tend to rally, and European natural gas risk premium eases. Both mappings are indirect and low-confidence given Polymarket noise and weak US-listed gas proxies; neither reliably clears the 700bps tradable bar within 12h, so this is flagged as a weak, research-only signal.
key_assumptions: A probability jump reflects real, not-yet-public diplomatic progress toward a settlement
De-escalation is interpreted by markets as net risk-on for the region
EPOL and the zloty remain the most liquid tradable proxies for Russia-Ukraine geopolitical risk
failure_modes: The move is driven by low-liquidity noise or a rumor that is quickly denied, reversing within hours
A deal is already in mainstream reporting, so assets have priced it and no edge exists
US gas proxy decouples from European gas due to weather/storage, invalidating the energy leg
Ceding territory is read as Russian strength and future escalation risk, flipping the equity sign
12h magnitude is well below 700bps, making the signal untradable under the stated threshold
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
